storage.tracked_outputs: suite definition and one aggregate current result only
storage.untracked_outputs: source annotations, selected media, prepared bundle, and runner scratch

source.media_scope: verified six-identity subset from the official test indices

license.handling: computational-use evaluation only; keep media outside Git

selection.positive_relation: later frames of the same object identity
selection.hard_negative_relation: a different object identity in the same category
selection.parameter_policy: frozen signed product defaults; no sweep

observation_contract.purpose: single-frame runtime wiring observation; not MonitoringSession, product Event, or accuracy evidence
observation_contract.interpretation: report all outcomes without an accuracy threshold

source.media_scope: 169 numbered JPEG files in the archive; 168 have published digit annotations and enter the replay set

selection.images: all 168 images carrying published digit annotations; archive image 97 is excluded because it has no annotation record
selection.mapping: anchored decimal file number at the end of each published image URL maps to the numbered archive JPEG
selection.scoring: read JPEG EXIF orientation, transform published boxes into upright normalized coordinates, sort by upright x, and compare expected_digits only; annotations contain no decimal-point truth

manual_roi_diagnostic.selection: fixed reviewed v1 file-number cohort; construction uses only published truth, includes EXIF-orientation cases 075 and 117, and has no runtime-output dependency
manual_roi_diagnostic.media_policy: reuse the original full-frame asset; do not generate cropped media

selection.parameter_policy: frozen signed product defaults; no sweep

observation_contract.purpose: full-frame and fixed manual-ROI runtime wiring observation; published annotations contain no decimal-point truth
observation_contract.interpretation: report all outcomes without an accuracy threshold or commercial claim

license.images: per-image Creative Commons license recorded by COCO
license.handling: preserve source identity and license metadata; do not commit or republish media

selection.cross_target_image_reuse: avoid for observational cases when another eligible image exists
selection.parameter_policy: frozen signed product defaults; no sweep
selection.largest_bbox_anchor_ranking: maximum eligible target bbox area ratio, then numeric image_id ascending
selection.largest_bbox_anchor_interpretation: largest-bbox observational stratum only; not a manually reviewed clear-image or recognition-accuracy gate

observation_contract.purpose: external runtime wiring observation; not a supplier benchmark or product accuracy claim
observation_contract.interpretation: report stratified outcomes and IoU diagnostics without a recognition threshold

camera_replay.scope_note: screen or emulator video replay validates camera and product rules; it is not an independent natural-scene accuracy claim
